title: The Eye of the World
author: Robert Jordan
summary: After a night attack on their quiet village, three young friends are hurried away by a mysterious woman and a wandering guide. They learn that they may be tied to a prophecy about a dark power returning to the world.
readIf: you want a classic, slow-building fantasy quest that opens up into a huge, richly layered world.
skipIf: you want fresh plotting, since the start borrows heavily from older fantasy, and it is long.

pairings.reason: The model for this opening, with a similar flight from home and a hidden danger on the road.
A faster, more tightly plotted epic fantasy with a crisp system of magic.
A simpler, younger-feeling fantasy with a similar farm-boy-to-hero beginning.
